page.overview:
Who is Ortho K. Gotch?

Ortho K. Gotch is one of the most skilled butlers in the world. He serves Dudley's family since the time Dudley's father was alive and is acquainted with Azam and Shibazaki.

Ortho appears in Dudley's victory pose, coming down from a helicopter to serve him tea.

In Dudley's ending, Dudley is shown to have lost track of time while tending his garden of roses, and Ortho reminds him of his royal match.
